children: Activist investor Elliott Investment Management has built a stake in Deutsche Telekom and is pushing the German company to abandon any effort to merge with T-Mobile US, according to people familiar with the matter.

Deutsche Telekom owns 54% of T-Mobile and has held discussions this year about combining the two companies to create a more streamlined telecom behemoth. The current status of any talks couldn't be learned.
Elliott favors Deutsche Telekom returning more cash to its shareholders through larger share buybacks over a T-Mobile deal, according to one of the people.
The market has largely taken a dim view of what could be a complex and drawn out merger, some investors have said. Shares of both companies weakened when news of deal talks first emerged in April.
On Thursday, Deutsche Telekom's stock traded higher in Germany, while T-Mobile's New York-listed shares rose in premarket trading.
Elliott's stake in Deutsche Telekom was earlier reported by Bloomberg News.
